versions.content: When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTpRxIndica- tion API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkTpRxIndication callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTpRxIndication call: • result The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTpRxIndication shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkTpRxIndication callback.
